narrative.overview:
This is a descriptive snapshot of the current v3 `/architecture` implementation, recorded on 2026-10-14. Its scope is the architecture reading surface inside the existing application shell. The metaphor describes the implementation; it is not a user-approved brand direction and must not be imposed on other routes.

The page moves from design principles to the system blueprint, execution paths, an illustrative evidence journey, module implementation and runtime boundaries. Editorial typography, a tactile illustration and varied diagram compositions support that reading sequence. Product facts remain in `PRODUCT.md`; source code remains the authority when this snapshot drifts.
keyCharacteristics: A readable Chinese editorial hierarchy with restrained technical labels.
Pale reading surfaces, a deep blueprint field and distinct evidence-path colors.
Art introduces the idea; interactive diagrams explain actual responsibilities.
Headings and their introductions share one left alignment; content groups stay close to their labels.
Light and dark themes, container-aware layouts and optional short motion.
rules: Section introductions place the heading above its description on one left axis, with a 12px gap.
The blueprint overview uses four bordered nodes with 8px corners and separate 24px arrow tracks, separated by 12px grid gaps. At 700px and below, nodes and arrows follow vertical reading order.
Blueprint nodes, the Pi host boundary and storage groups use 8px corners. Short 14px vertical connectors join internal nodes; there are no floating buses or percentage-positioned SVG routes.

Shared knowledge storage groups MinIO and Qdrant with their write/read responsibilities. Pi runtime records group SQLite and local files with Pi-host-only persistence. Storage icons use Lucide at 22px with stroke width 1.5.

Module tabs are horizontal and reflow from eight columns to four at 1100px and two at 540px. At 350px they show names only, and contract labels stack above descriptions. Module panels use natural content height, with prose bounded at 58em.
Mechanism titles and descriptions are vertically adjacent in one copy block; the evidence journey aligns explanatory and evidence columns at the top with natural content height.
Runtime storage scope labels follow their description in the same content column. Runtime disclosure tags remain next to their title.
dos: Do keep this document scoped to `/architecture` and refresh it against the actual CSS when that surface changes.
Do use source-linked explanatory content and label the evidence journey as illustrative.
Do verify both themes, narrow layouts, keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't imply this snapshot is a user-approved product-wide identity.
Don't treat conceptual artwork, illustrative traces or color coding as proof of runtime behavior.
Don't flatten the page into repeated cards or add continuous motion that competes with reading.
Don't reintroduce overlaid arrows, floating buses, fixed-height empty panels or detached labels in the system diagram and reading sections.
